branding.label: Branding
branding.hint: Site icon, colors and logo. Empty fields use the site settings (or the defaults).

home.label: Home
home.hint: Areas and counts on the home screen. An area stays hidden while its module is turned off.

favicon.label: Favicon
favicon.hint: Icon shown on the browser tab of user screens while this template is active.

accent.label: Accent color
accent.hint: Color of buttons, links and notice boxes.

color_scheme.label: Default color mode
color_scheme.hint: Mode shown to first-time visitors. Visitors who already picked a mode (including this browser) keep their choice.

logo_dark.label: Dark mode logo
logo_dark.hint: Logo used on dark screens. Leave empty to keep the site logo.

max_boards.label: Board menu items
max_boards.hint: How many boards show directly when "All boards (auto)" is a top-level item. The rest go under "More".

menu.label: Header menu
menu.hint: Used for the top menu and the mobile menu. Drag to reorder; drag right to make a sub-menu (dropdown).

home.label: Home
home.hint: Link to the site home page.

popular.label: Popular posts
popular.hint: Popular posts across boards. Hidden when the board module is off.

shop.label: Shop
shop.hint: Product list. Hidden when the shop module is off.

boards.label: All boards (auto)
boards.hint: New boards are added here automatically. At the top level it shows as many boards as "Board menu count" and puts the rest under "More"; as a sub-menu it lists every board in that dropdown.

copyright.label: Copyright text
copyright.hint: Leave empty to use the default (year and site name). Empty languages use the default language text.

product_count.label: Products
product_count.hint: Products shown in each popular/new group.

menu.empty: The menu is empty. Click "Add link" to start.
menu.drag_hint: Drag the handle to reorder. Drag right to nest it under the item above; drag left to move it back up.
menu.select_hint: Select an item on the left to edit it here.
menu.label: Menu name
menu.auto_label_hint: Leave empty to use the default name.
menu.url_hint: A site path (/board/notice) or a full address (https://…). A parent menu with sub-menus may leave it empty.
menu.visibility_hint: This only hides the menu item. It does not block access to the page.
menu.delete_confirm_children: Its {{count}} sub-menu items will be deleted too. Delete?
menu.delete_confirm_children_one: Its {{count}} sub-menu item will be deleted too. Delete?
